units: <cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 3:3">Bets. III, 3</cite> (<cite ref="Beitzah 25a">25ᵃ</cite>), v. <cite ref="M00460"><he>מוֹט</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: pl. מוֹטוֹת bands of a yoke; yoke. Tanḥ.
units: <cite ref="Exodus 23">B’shall. 23</cite> <he>והיו מ׳ ומרכבות וכ׳</he> the yokes and the chariots ran (of themselves) &c.

senses.gloss: balances. Pesik. B’shall., p. 82ᵃ במטה דאמיטין אתמיט להון Ar. with the balance with which they weighed, weighing was done to them; [Ar.: as they made others sink, so were they made to sink (v. מוּט); oth. opin.: במַטֶּה וכ׳ with the staff with which they struck, were they struck].
